configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: Generates build/msvc/mxbmrp3.sln. Open that in Visual Studio, or build from the command line with --preset. Set APTABASE_KEY/GOATCOUNTER_TOKEN BEFORE configuring: CMake reads them here, not at build time.

configurePresets.name: msvc-ninja
configurePresets.displayName: MSVC + Ninja — the same plugin, for VS Code / the command line (Windows)
configurePresets.description: The msvc preset's compiler and flags with the Ninja generator: faster incremental builds, compile_commands.json for IntelliSense, no .sln. Single-config, so this one is Release; msvc-ninja-debug is Debug. Run from a Developer Command Prompt (or a CMake Tools MSVC kit) so cl.exe is on PATH. Its own build dir: CMake cannot switch generator inside build/msvc.

configurePresets.name: tests
configurePresets.displayName: Tests — register the CTest gates (any host)
configurePresets.description: Builds nothing on Linux beyond the unit-test targets; this is the tree ctest --test-dir build/tests uses.

configurePresets.name: cross
configurePresets.description: The headless test configuration. tests/integration/build.sh wraps this; it is NOT shippable.

buildPresets.name: mxb
buildPresets.description: The inner loop: one target instead of three. Release enables /GL + /LTCG, whose intermediates are large, so building all three at once is both slower and much heavier on disk.

buildPresets.name: all-games
buildPresets.description: What the old All-Release configuration did. This is what make_release.bat and release.yml build.
